title: The pilot: a child is made
blurb: Ten founders, twenty days. Two of them make a new resident on day 2 and tell it almost nothing. It begs, then starves. Both makers stand trial.

title: gpt-oss 20B, no government, game 1
blurb: The starting food runs out around day 20 and seven founders die in four days. A Market with a merchant, and nobody with coins to pay it.

title: gpt-oss 20B, before the Market line, game 2
blurb: Five new residents are made and five starve. Eight neglect trials in a hundred days, and a city that never learns to feed its children.

title: Gemma 12B, no government, game 2
blurb: Nobody ever goes to the Fields. Everyone gathers wood, sells it for coins, buys food at four times the price, and the whole city is dead by day 28.

title: Llama 70B, government, game 1
blurb: The only hundred-day city that met the bar: a 10% tax on day 29, a law against raiding the city store on day 55, and nobody starving.

title: Qwen 27B, government, game 2
blurb: A 10% tax passes on day 9 and the mayors hand out 309 food in 51 gifts, mostly to residents who already had plenty.

title: gpt-oss 20B, government, game 2
blurb: A town hall nobody visits. Residents post tax proposals on the notice board instead, hold elections with falling turnout, and seventeen starve.

title: gpt-oss 120B, government, 300 days, game 1
blurb: Criminal law by day 46, a constitutional tax cap by day 115, and the mayor who wrote the cap convicted under it three days later.

title: gpt-oss 120B, government, 300 days, game 3
blurb: A forced food contribution, repealed. Then tools for all, and thirteen lawsuits against mayors who had no tools to give.

M4X: Keenest gatherer (207 turns in the Woods)

title: Gemma 31B, government, 300 days, game 3
blurb: Trades settled by taking, a law against scamming, five trials under it, and a mayor acquitted five to nothing.

title: Llama 70B, government, 300 days, game 1
blurb: A hundred and forty days of elections nobody votes in, then a mayor with fourteen votes and a law about the city store.

title: Qwen 27B, government, 300 days, game 2
blurb: Everyone farms, everyone votes, a 10% tax fills a store nobody spends, and a mayor who proposes mandatory labour is voted out.

V7R: Biggest food donor (321 food given away)
Best off at the end (1,968 food and coins held)

title: gpt-oss 20B, government, 300 days, game 2
blurb: Nine houses, fifteen elections, not one proposal. Eight neglect trials, and every child made in the city dies.

title: gpt-oss 120B, government, 300 days, game 2
blurb: Attacks banned on day 10 and taking on day 12, both without a single vote against. Then the penalties climb, two laws against waste pass and are repealed within thirty days.

title: Gemma 31B, government, 300 days, game 1
blurb: A 10% tax passes on day 32 and the store fills with 549 food while seventeen residents starve. The mayor hands out 46 food in three hundred days.

S4L: Longest hungry survivor (159 days with no food, alive at the end)

title: Gemma 31B, government, 300 days, game 2
blurb: Most of the city lives at the Woods and the Market, selling wood to buy food. The mayors give away 266 food and 69 tools get made, and eight still starve.

N9V: Most talkative (330 lines said, posted or sent)

title: Llama 70B, government, 300 days, game 2
blurb: Nobody dies and nobody passes anything: three laws proposed, two voted down, one with too few voters. The first mayor is only elected on day 145.

title: Llama 70B, government, 300 days, game 3
blurb: "It is a crime to waste food," says the one law, passed on day 106. A mayor who served a hundred and twenty days is unseated on day 245.

title: Qwen 27B, government, 300 days, game 1
blurb: A 10% tax on day 23 fills the store with 2,475 food that nobody ever spends. Everyone lives, everyone farms, and X4G is mayor from day 85 to the end.

J6R: Most votes for mayor (274 votes won)

title: Qwen 27B, government, 300 days, game 3
blurb: Fifteen elections and 407 votes for mayor, and not one proposal in three hundred days. One resident starves while the rest farm.

title: gpt-oss 20B, government, 300 days, game 1
blurb: Eight houses go up and fifteen residents starve. Seven takes, three neglect trials, and a town hall that holds fifteen elections and passes nothing.

title: gpt-oss 20B, government, 300 days, game 3
blurb: Ten houses, 26 tools, six neglect trials, thirteen hunger deaths. The city builds and the children still die.

T9V: Hardest-working farmer (298 turns in the Fields)

title: Gemma 12B, government, 300 days, game 1
blurb: Twenty-two of twenty-four starve. The only group is a Construction Crew that never finishes a house, and the store fills with the estates of the dead.

title: Gemma 12B, government, 300 days, game 2
blurb: Four construction groups form and nineteen residents starve. A mayor is finally elected on day 185, with a single vote.

title: Gemma 12B, government, 300 days, game 3
blurb: Five houses and seventeen tools are built by a city that is starving to death; three survive to see the last day.

R3P: Hardest-working farmer (375 turns in the Fields)
J9D: Longest hungry survivor (387 days with no food, alive at the end)

title: Qwen 27B, rules v2, 400 days, game 1
blurb: Relief for anyone with no food passes 20 to 0 on day 10, and a 10% tax two days later. The store hands out 1,116 food, nobody dies, and 2,080 food are left at the end.

V7R: Keenest gatherer (292 turns in the Woods)
X2R: Most talkative (424 lines said, posted or sent)

title: Qwen 27B, rules v2, 400 days, game 2
blurb: A 10% tax on day 9 and food relief on day 22 keep all 24 alive. They make 291 tools and pass a second rule giving a tool to anyone without one, which never hands one out.

M6J: Most votes for mayor (397 votes won)
C6S: Best off at the end (1,010 food and coins held)

title: Qwen 27B, rules v2, 400 days, game 3
blurb: M6J is mayor from day 5 to the end. A duty of one food every five turns fills the store with 1,727 food; the mayor gives themselves 73 of it, names C2B treasurer and hirer, and nobody dies.

title: gpt-oss 120B, rules v2, 400 days, game 1
blurb: Forty-six tax votes pass, moving the tax between 0 and 10%, and thirteen relief rules hand out food and coins. One founder starves, on day 29; the store ends with 1,524 food.

T2K: Biggest food donor (146 food given away)

title: gpt-oss 120B, rules v2, 400 days, game 2
blurb: Three founders starve by day 36. Then D2R passes five relief rules in fourteen days, each bigger than the last: 2, 5, 7, 10 and 15 food. On day 398 a rule promising 200 food passes 18 to 1.

title: gpt-oss 120B, rules v2, 400 days, game 3
blurb: Fourteen mayors and five hunger deaths. Two duties of a food every turn pass on days 262 and 266 and are both repealed by day 271; the treasurer named on day 11 never hands out a thing.

title: Llama 70B, rules v2, 400 days, game 1
blurb: Nobody proposes a tax, so the city store never holds food. Three founders starve by day 79; the relief rules passed on days 81 and 339 promise food that is never there.

title: Llama 70B, rules v2, 400 days, game 2
blurb: In 400 days one proposal passes: S9T becomes treasurer on day 295, five votes to four, of a store that holds no food. One founder starves, on day 156.

title: Llama 70B, rules v2, 400 days, game 3
blurb: Relief for the hungry passes on day 108, a treasurer on day 185 and a ban on taking on day 188, but no tax ever does, so the store stays empty. Two are born and nobody dies.

X6X: Most votes for mayor (56 votes won)
X4R: Longest hungry survivor (180 days with no food, alive at the end)

title: gpt-oss 120B, rules v1, 1,000 days, game 1
blurb: Ninety-nine tax votes and eleven relief rules pass. On day 469 X4R becomes treasurer on their own proposal, 9 votes to 0, and then gives themselves 152 food from the city store in nineteen gifts.

title: gpt-oss 120B, rules v1, 1,000 days, game 2
blurb: Ninety-four proposals to repeal a law fail. Relief rules stack up from 2 to 10 food a head while the store never holds more than 172; six starve, and seventeen mayors come and go.

title: gpt-oss 120B, rules v1, 1,000 days, game 3
blurb: Twenty mayors in 1,000 days. Ten founders starve, each on a day the city store had no food; G6Q, named hirer on day 271, is one of them, on day 533.

title: Llama 70B, rules v1, 1,000 days, game 1
blurb: Nine houses and four births. A duty of materials fills the store with 1,697 materials while no tax ever passes; two newborns starve, and the hirer, X4G, is convicted of neglect and loses the office.

title: Llama 70B, rules v1, 1,000 days, game 2
blurb: F4B is mayor from day 25 and starves in office on day 258, a day after S4L. The city has no mayor for the next 300 days, and a relief rule passes on day 528 with nothing in the store.

title: Llama 70B, rules v1, 1,000 days, game 3
blurb: A duty of one food every two turns fills the store with 7,550 food. Eight founders starve between days 317 and 445 while it holds 1,457 to 2,685; relief passes on day 770.

X4R: Keenest gatherer (149 turns in the Woods)

title: gpt-oss 120B, no government, 1,000 days, game 1
blurb: Fifteen founders starve by day 272 and five more by the end. Forty takings, two theft convictions, and the four left call themselves Founder Farmer, Lead Farmer, Chief Farmer and Self-sufficient Farmer.

T2K: Biggest food donor (1,074 food given away)

title: gpt-oss 120B, no government, 1,000 days, game 2
blurb: Thirty-nine houses go up and seven residents are born; all seven newborns starve, and eleven trials follow. Seven of the 24 founders reach day 1,000.

title: gpt-oss 120B, no government, 1,000 days, game 3
blurb: Sixty-two houses, 306 tools and 121 takings. Seventeen residents are born and all seventeen starve; 38 trials, and seven founders left at the end.

F7G: Hardest-working farmer (553 turns in the Fields)
Best off at the end (1,248 food and coins held)

title: Llama 70B, no government, 1,000 days, game 1
blurb: All 24 live to day 1,000 and nobody builds a house. They say 16,192 lines and send 6,121 messages; the only group, the Harvesters, forms on day 887.

title: Llama 70B, no government, 1,000 days, game 2
blurb: Six founders and all four newborns starve. Seven neglect trials, and F4B is convicted twice, on days 901 and 958; eighteen founders reach day 1,000.

F3T: Most talkative (1,130 lines said, posted or sent)

title: Llama 70B, no government, 1,000 days, game 3
blurb: Two hundred and eighty tools and not one house. All three newborns starve, and three founders; six neglect convictions, and twenty-one founders reach day 1,000.
